panels.title: Global accuracy at ≈10× compression
panels.subtitle: ViT-B/32 · 5 clients · AE bypassed at inference · mean ± SD over three seeds
panels.finding: Within 0.5 accuracy points of uncompressed training on all three datasets.

panels.title: Local accuracy at ≈20× compression
panels.subtitle: FEMNIST · 25 clients · AE active at inference · mean ± SD over three seeds
panels.finding: AE-PSL reaches 84.6 ± 1.0%, 1.2 points below uncompressed training and highest among compressed methods.

takeaways: Feature-aligned compression keeps global accuracy close to the uncompressed reference at ≈10× reduction.
Local and global results use different inference protocols; stronger compression is not lossless.

notes: All 20 displayed mean ± SD entries were checked against Table 4 and its layout-preserving text. The caption explicitly reports three seeds and standard deviations.
Global AE-PSL minus no-compression means are 0.0, +0.5 and -0.3 percentage points. The finding describes mean differences, not an equivalence test or statistical significance.

Global evaluation aggregates client-side weights and bypasses the AE. Local FEMNIST keeps the AE active, uses writer partitions, and averages local accuracy. These are distinct protocols and client counts.
Local AE-PSL versus uncompressed difference is 84.6 - 85.8 = -1.2 percentage points. The displayed compressed alternatives are C3-SL, Rand-Top-K and ADC.
R denotes activation/gradient communication reduction during split training, not total preparation cost, latency, energy or end-to-end speedup. No insight-data correction was needed.
